answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_key) AS orders_placed
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
WHERE
  order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_key) AS orders,
  MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date,
  MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line

SELECT
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN order_key
    END
  ) AS orders_placed_in_2024,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN delivery_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND delivery_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN order_key
    END
  ) AS orders_delivered_in_2024,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS lines_placed_in_2024,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN order_date
    END
  ) AS first_order_date_in_window,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN order_date
    END
  ) AS last_order_date_in_window
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line

body.value: 15,899 is the number of distinct orders Contoso recorded as placed during the calendar year 2024 — one count per order, not one per order line — over a window whose contents run the full span 1 January to 31 December 2024. Those 15,899 orders carry 38,109 lines between them, which is what a line-grain reading would have returned instead. WHAT I DID NOT INCLUDE: nothing was excluded on status, because this bundle holds no order status at all — no cancelled, returned, failed or draft flag exists anywhere on the sales line, so every order the warehouse records as placed is counted and none could have been removed. Nothing was excluded on channel: web-shop orders are in alongside the physical shops. Nothing was excluded on customer, product, store or currency. And this is not the delivered-in-2024 figure, which is 15,917.
